findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-slack_android" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_channels, search_people, thread_replies, conversation_history, open_conversation, list_workspaces · Public sink: search_people, post_message_rich, reply_thread, post_message, list_workspaces, confirm_email_signin · Destructive: session_status, delete_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_channels, search_people, thread_replies, conversation_history, open_conversation, list_workspaces · Public sink: search_people, post_message_rich, reply_thread, post_message, list_workspaces, confirm_email_signin · Destructive: session_status, delete_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
